  1. Every MUST requirement has a runnable integration test file (TC-ISS-0123-01 and TC-ISS-0123-02 cover Clusters A and B respectively)

  3. Fixtures use per-test UUIDs (verify the newUuid() helper is used)
  4. Tests clean up after themselves (defer h.deinit() pattern)

Also check pipeline tests per the additional checks:
  - Every MUST that involves sequential UI action has a pl.step() in the relevant pipeline file under web/tests/e2e/pipelines/ (probably N/A here — this is a backend DB fix, not a UI flow)
  - tests/specs/PIPELINE-<slug>.md exists for the journey (N/A here)
  - web/tests/e2e/pipeline.ts helpers used (N/A here)
  - pl.onCleanup() registered (N/A here)
  - No test.beforeEach / test.afterEach inside pipeline files (N/A here)

FAIL if any HARD check fails (test is missing, has SkipZigTest, has mocks, fails isolation). The wiring check is MAJOR (notes in issues, but not block).

On PASS, set next_action: "Route to TEST-RUNNER (Step 5)" and ensure the wiring MAJOR is included in issues for follow-up by BACKEND-DEV.
